A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] occurred in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberation campaign after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Prelude==
One month after the Battle of Endor in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the New Republic began a campaign to liberate [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[New Republic Fourth Fleet|Fourth Fleet]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Voon Massa]], operated out of the New Republic redoubt of [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]] into [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]], securing the key industrial world of [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] in 4 ABY, and in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], fighting the grueling three-month [[Milagro campaign]] against Imperial forces led by Admiral [[Uther Kermen]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

After securing the [[Milagro system/Legends|Milagro system]], the Fourth Fleet advanced and [[Battle of Spirana|captured]] the [[Spirana system/Legends|Spirana system]] from the Galactic Empire, giving the New Republic a foothold in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. There they consolidated in preparation for the resumption of the offensive the next year.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==The battle==
In 6 ABY, the New Republic Fourth Fleet advanced from Spirana into the [[Denon system/Legends|Denon system]], engaging Admiral Kermen's Imperial fleet over the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] world. The battle was a savage engagement in which Admiral Massa was killed, but his second-in-command, Admiral [[Chel Dorat]], successfully broke the Imperial lines, driving Admiral Kermen from the system.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Aftermath==
The costly New Republic victory advanced its front on the Corellian Run to the edge of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and secured the crossroads of the Run and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Together with the [[New Republic First Fleet|First Fleet's]] [[Siege of Bomis Koori|defeat]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Utoxx Prentioch|Prentioch]] at [[Bomis Koori IV]], and the [[New Republic Third Fleet|Third Fleet's]] victories at [[Battle of Reytha|Reytha]] and [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (6 ABY)|Uviuy Exen]], the capture of Denon advanced Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar's]] plan to encircle the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] in preparation for the [[Core Campaign|capture]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
